findings.ai_note: REAL — Different user-specific content is returned for adjacent IDs, indicating missing authorization checks.
findings.remediation:
Enforce server‑side access control by verifying that the authenticated user is authorized to view the requested resource before returning its data.  
For example, in PHP you can add: `if (!userCanView($authUserId, $id)) { http_response_code(403); exit; }`.  
Apply this check to every endpoint that uses the `id` parameter to prevent unauthorized data exposure.
